summary.one_liner: Login page for the Hangops Slack workspace (hangops.slack.com), where the #sre channel discusses site reliability engineering; the page itself only shows a browser-unsupported notice and app download links.

find the sre channel in a slack workspace
sign in to a slack workspace from an unsupported browser
summary.what_it_does: The page is the sign-in entry point for the hangops.slack.com workspace, which is a Slack workspace. It shows a notice that the current browser is not supported and suggests upgrading or using a Slack app instead. It lists desktop app downloads for Mac, Windows and Linux (version v4.53.276, each with system requirements links) and mobile app links for iOS and Android. The text does not describe the workspace's channels or membership beyond what the listing says about the #sre channel.
notable: Community Slack workspace listed in awesome-sre with an #sre channel for site reliability engineering
Desktop apps for Mac, Windows and Linux at version v4.53.276
Page is a browser-unsupported notice, not the chat itself
caveats: Page only shows a browser-unsupported message; the workspace content was not visible
Sign-in may be required to access channels and messages
